title: PhotoBench: Beyond Visual Matching Towards Personalized Intent-Driven Photo Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2603.01493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Personal photo albums are not merely collections of static images but living, ecological archives defined by temporal continuity, social entanglement, and rich metadata, which makes the personalized photo retrieval non-trivial. However, existing retrieval benchmarks rely heavily on context-isolated web snapshots, failing to capture the multi-source reasoning required to resolve authentic, intent-driven user queries. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhotoBench, the first benchmark constructed from authentic, personal albums. It is designed to shift the paradigm from visual matching to personalized multi-source intent-driven reasoning. Based on a rigorous multi-source profiling framework, which integrates visual semantics, spatial-temporal metadata, social identity, and temporal events for each image, we synthesize complex intent-driven queries rooted in users' life trajectories. translated_title: PhotoBench：超越视觉匹配，迈向个性化意图驱动的照片检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.01493v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：个人照片专辑不仅仅是静态图像的集合，而是由时间连续性、社会纠缠和丰富元数据定义的活生生的生态档案，这使得个性化照片检索变得非平凡。然而，现有的检索基准严重依赖上下文孤立的网络快照，未能捕捉解决真实、意图驱动的用户查询所需的多源推理。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了PhotoBench，这是第一个基于真实个人专辑构建的基准。它旨在将范式从视觉匹配转向个性化多源意图驱动推理。基于一个严格的多源档案框架，该框架为每张图像整合了视觉语义、时空元数据、社会身份和时间事件，我们综合了根植于用户生活轨迹的复杂意图驱动查询。在PhotoBench上的广泛评估暴露了两个严重问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了PhotoBench，这是首个基于真实个人相册的基准，通过多源推理框架将个性化照片检索从视觉匹配转向意图驱动，以解决现有基准忽视生活轨迹和元数据的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PhotoBench, the first benchmark built from authentic personal albums, shifting personalized photo retrieval from visual matching to intent-driven multi-source reasoning by integrating visual, spatial-temporal, social, and temporal metadata.
